status_assumption: Whole-order status snapshot at cutoff; no status history, partial refunds, tax, or currency conversion
attribution: One originating session per order; one channel per session. All paid orders observed before cutoff are attributed to the originating session month, even if order month differs.

converted_sessions.definition: Distinct eligible sessions with at least one paid order before cutoff

paid_revenue.definition: SUM(amount_eur) for paid orders before cutoff belonging to eligible session cohorts

paid_order_count.definition: COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) for paid orders before cutoff belonging to eligible sessions
